content.rendered:
Now Open! Kindergarten and new student registration for 2024-25. If you have a student new to our district and would like to get them enrolled for this fall, please follow this link for more information.

For Kindergarten information, please check out this Kindergarten Special Edition Newsletter filled with lots of information specific to Kindergarten. Feel free to share this link with anyone you know that has an incoming kindergartner. If you have any questions, please call the Hawks View Office at 503-825-5400.
